krs.message: This is the default rotation system used in this game. Uses Sonic Drop and Fast Drop.

srs.message: This rotation system is used in most games. You are likely familiar with this one. Uses Hard Drop and Soft Drop.

srsx.message: Similar to SRS, but Zangi-moves are possible. Uses Sonic Drop and Fast Drop.

ars.message: This rotation system is strict but easy to understand. Pieces cannot floor kick. Uses Sonic Drop and Fast Drop.

arsti.message: Similar to ARS, but with modified T and I kicks. Uses Sonic Drop and Fast Drop.

arsx.message: Similar to ARS-TI, but with less limitations. Uses Sonic Drop and Fast Drop.

world.message: Similar to SRS, but with modified I kicks. Uses Hard Drop and Soft Drop.

ds.message: Similar to SRS, but piece ARE is gone, making it harder on high gravity. Uses Hard Drop and Soft Drop.

drs.message: The rotation system KRS is based on. Both piece ARE and line ARE can be cancelled using DAS. Uses Hard Drop and Soft Drop.
